description: This file defines a handler class for interfacing with HuggingFace embedding models, including functions for model task retrieval, input transformation, and embedding response processing. It includes both synchronous and asynchronous methods for embedding inference.

classes.name: HuggingFaceEmbedding
classes.description: A class for interacting with HuggingFace embedding models, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous operations, input transformation, and response processing.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_hf_task_embedding_for_model( model: str, task_type: Optional[str], api_base: str )
methods.description: Retrieves the task type (e.g., 'embed', 'sentence-similarity') for a specified model via a model info API.

methods.name: Optional[str] async_get_hf_task_embedding_for_model( model: str, task_type: Optional[str], api_base: str )
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the task type for a model from HuggingFace API.

methods.name: dict _transform_input_on_pipeline_tag( self, input: List, pipeline_tag: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Transforms input data based on the pipeline tag, mainly for sentence similarity or rerank tasks.

methods.name: dict _async_transform_input( self, model: str, task_type: Optional[str], embed_url: str, input: List, optional_params: dict, )
methods.description: Prepares input data asynchronously by fetching the task and transforming the input accordingly.

methods.name: dict _process_optional_params(self, data: dict, optional_params: dict)
methods.description: Processes optional parameters, separating special options, parameters, and general options.

methods.name: dict _transform_input( self, input: List, model: str, call_type: Literal["sync", "async"], optional_params: dict, embed_url: str, )
methods.description: Main method to transform input data based on model, call type, and optional parameters.

methods.name: EmbeddingResponse _process_embedding_response( self, embeddings: dict, model_response: EmbeddingResponse, model: str, input: List, encoding: Any, )
methods.description: Processes the raw embeddings into a structured response, including statistics calculation.
